purpose: Immutable ARIEC61850 revision for ARSAS CI, tests, packaging, diagnostics, and release provenance. Baseline includes connected reconciliation, COMTRADE/MMS FileOpen interoperability, UTC-Time wire provenance, typed signal catalog query/coverage APIs, and authoritative hybrid reporting. PR #75 adds bounded live DataSet-directory discovery and permits a verified-free dynamic RCB to own a temporary DataSet whose members reside in other logical devices. ARSAS consumes these typed engine decisions and does not recreate IEC report capability heuristics.
